subject: Testing measurement invariance for second-oder models

messages.author: 849f474a7d77f108
messages.subject: Testing measurement invariance for second-oder models
parts:
Hi all,

I have a model with three latent variables and one second-order factor.

I tested measurement invariance for the first-order model using the equaltestMI package. Does anybody have an idea how to test measurement invariance for the second order model using R? Would be great if there would be a package which supports it.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Testing measurement invariance for second-oder models
parts: Does anybody have an idea how to test measurement invariance for the second order model using R?

Check out the measEq.syntax() function in the semTools package, and read the Details section of the help page carefully for details about second-order models.  It will help you write lavaan syntax to test invariance.
